name: Handles, Reads & Finishing
summary: Warm up your handle, groove your shot from the slot, make fast decisions on a short clock, then finish at the rim with tired legs.

drills.name: Behind-the-Back Walk-Ups
drills.summary: Wake up your hands with controlled behind-the-back dribbles while you walk.
steps: Start on the baseline in a low stance.
Walk forward and go behind the back with every step.
Keep the ball tight to your hip and push it to the other hand.
At half court, turn around and walk back the same way.
Last minute, add a hard pound dribble before each behind-the-back.

drills.name: Slot Spot-Up Ladder
drills.summary: Hit two in a row from each slot spot before you move back.
steps: Start at the right slot, just inside the free throw line extended.
Toss the ball out, catch on a hop, and shoot.
Make two in a row, then take one step back.
Climb three spots back, then switch to the left slot.
If you miss two straight, step back in one spot.

drills.name: Shot Clock Attack Reps
drills.summary: Beat an 8-second clock and pick the best shot you can get.
steps: Set your phone to beep every 8 seconds.
Start at half court with the ball when it beeps.
Attack and choose: layup, pull-up, or kick-out to a spot and shoot.
Get the shot off before the next beep.
Say your choice out loud before you shoot it.

drills.name: Three-Dribble Rim Attacks
drills.summary: Get from the top of the key to the rim in three dribbles or less, then run back.
steps: Start at the top of the key, just behind the arc.
Attack the rim using three dribbles or fewer.
Finish with a right-hand layup on the right side, left hand on the left.
Grab the ball and sprint back to the top.
Alternate sides every rep and keep going until time runs out.
